title: A finite type algebra over a field is Jacobson: every prime is the intersection of the maximal ideals containing it
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $B$ be a finite type $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Then $B$ is a Jacobson ring: for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset B$, $\mathfrak p$ equals the intersection of all maximal ideals $\mathfrak m\subset B$ with $\mathfrak p\subseteq\mathfrak m$. In particular, for every $f\in B$ with $f\notin\mathfrak p$ there is a maximal ideal $\mathfrak m\supseteq\mathfrak p$ of $B$ with $f\notin\mathfrak m$.
